attchmntText: Priti International Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Priti International Limited filed an intimation under Regulation 47 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015 regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published in Financial Express in English and Business Remedies in Hindi. The filing was signed by Prem Karnani, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The document includes an extract of standalone financial results for the specified period, with figures in lakhs of rupees.

attchmntText: Priti International Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Priti International Limited announced the approval of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, by its Board of Directors on November 14, 2026. The company reported a profit before tax of 15.32 lakh rupees for the quarter and 38.19 lakh rupees for the half year. Net profit for the period was 11.50 lakh rupees for the quarter and 28.59 lakh rupees for the half year. Earnings per share stood at 0.10 for the quarter and 0.22 for the half year. Revenue from operations was 354.30 lakh rupees for the quarter and 774.14 lakh rupees for the half year. The statutory auditors, P Singhvi & Associates, issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were identified. The results are available on the company website.
